newsitem.title: USA: MBNA priced $1 bln credit card receivables.
newsitem.headline: MBNA priced $1 bln credit card receivables.

text.p: MBNA Corp said on Friday that its MBNA America Bank N.A. unit priced $1.0 billion of 7 year floating rate credit card asset-backed securities.

The securitization from the MBNA Master Credit Card Trust II consists of two classes of publicly traded securities - class A and class B - and a separate class of privately placed collateral invested amounts, the company said.

The transaction consists of $850 million class A senior floating rate asset-backed certificates, $75 million class B subordinate floating rate asset-backed certificates and a $75 million privately placed class of floating rate asset backed certificates.
Both the Class A and Class B certificates were priced at par, MBNA said.
The 7 year Class A certificates accrue interest at 13 basis points over the one month London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).
The 7.1 year Class B certificates accrue interest at 35 basis points over one month LIBOR.
The deal, which is scheduled to close October 24, 1996, was underwritten by Goldman Sachs & Co.
